what: TinyLlama WikiText-2 perplexity with the baseline recipe's arithmetic in every linear layer except the attention projections, next to the unpatched bf16 model. models/mxquant's perplexity path measures it; tests/selftest_workload.py [6] checks a cached measurement in the same environment against these numbers exactly.
taken: 2026-09-24; hardware entry and the reducer ablations re-taken 2026-09-28 on mxq 93c7047; every .venv entry re-taken 2026-09-29 on mxq ea3f5bb under the two-recipe config (config/hardware + config/run)
note: The bf16 model's own loss depends on the torch / transformers versions (same 16 samples, same token counts, per-token loss differs by up to 1e-2 either way), so every number is tied to its environment. Under torch 2.9.1 / transformers 4.57.3 the chain recipe -> config/scheme -> models/accuracy reproduces mxq's recorded runs exactly: hw_fp8 (block.mxgemmini ties_away, 1e-38 floor, HW_FINAL ladder, matmul.compiled(MXGEMMINI)) = 7.343833269506588 and the bf16 model = 7.188464705866791, which are MXQuant's published bf16 measurement conditions. The standing regression number for the hardware's rounding (rne, 2^-23 floor) is the .venv one; it is expected to differ from the ties_away number because bf16 activations tie on about 1 in 16 elements when rounded to e4m3. mxq 93c7047 adds the hardware's product flush (a product below 2^-16 is zero, MxFPMul PROD_FLOOR): the hardware number moved from 7.365560971111733 (mxq 5ee8bd4..f6f94d2) to 7.363709878432006 on the same 16 samples, so the flush does change bits in a real model. The 'reduce' entries share the quantizers with the hardware entry and differ only in the multiply (config.scheme.REDUCERS): exact is mxq's fp64_accum, bf16_tiles is exact inside each 32-block and the hardware's bf16 step across blocks. 2026-09-29: the hardware recipe now carries the flush as types.prodFloor and the operand rounding lives in the run recipe, so build_id moved from 854265d56bd38674 to 7e2a442ca9f1a819 and every key moved with it. Re-measured, the rne, exact and bf16_tiles entries and the bf16 model are unchanged to the last digit. The .venv ties_away entry had been taken before the flush: with prodFloor null it is still 7.346033921276218 exactly, and with the flush it is 7.3469974682860535, which is the entry now. The two mxq-environment entries (torch 2.9.1) are also from before the flush and are not re-measured here; the selftest skips them in the .venv. 2026-10-02: the hardware recipe now carries its LUT unit (mx.lut, the RTL GemminiLUTConfig) and enable_lut true, so build_id moved from 7e2a442ca9f1a819 to b9e05c7855dfec41. Re-measured, the four .venv entries (rne, ties_away, exact, bf16_tiles) are unchanged to the last digit.
